d1148.Raw_Article: 1148 Ta. kaṭṭu (kaṭṭi-) to harden, consolidate, congeal, coagulate, be congested (as the throat), swell (as a boil, tumour); n. boil, abscess, tumour; firmness, strength; kaṭṭukkāval strict guard; kaṭṭi clod, lump, concretion, anything hardened, coagulated, boil, abscess, tumour, enlarged spleen, foetus; keṭṭi firmness, hardness, strength; ( -pp-, -tt- ) to harden, strengthen, make firm; keṇṭai, keṇṭai-kkaṭṭi enlargement of the spleen.
